questions.question: In 8 bit comparator, the cascading input of most significant comparator should be connected to ___________.

answers.a: to the cascading outputs from the least significant comparator.
answers.b: to the cascading inputs of the least significant comparator.
answers.c: A = B to a logic high, A < B and A > B to a logic low.
